thread:
Marina Liao: Quick proposal — add an optional preflight + routing hint for the embeddings endpoint to improve latency for mixed-dim batches. TL;DR: client sends dims header, router can choose dim-compatible shard before enqueueing to batcher.

Ajay Patel: curious about quota counting — if we split a single request across shards how do we invoice tokens/units?

Marina Liao: thinking we keep accounting at the request-level (client sees 1 request), but internally we increment per-shard token usage so RBAC & quota dashboards reflect actual GPU spend. will need a mapping table.

Sam Brooks: note: our continuous batcher will still try to coalesce; if pre-routing sends to shard A for 768 dims and shard B for 1024, we risk small batches -> latency regressions unless we allow cross-dim batching fallback.

Dena Kim: can we add telemetry events: preflight.dim_hint, router.choice, batch_size, enqueue_delay_ms, fallback_reason? want to surface in console as per-route latency breakdown.

Chris O'Neill: agree on telemetry. Also propose a console UI card: "Embeds routing quality" with filters: model, dims, route, percent fallback, p95 latency.

Marina Liao: sample header proposal: `X-Embed-Dims: 768` or `X-Embed-Dims: 768,1024` for multi-vector responses. server returns `X-Embed-Routed-Shard: embed-v1-768`

Ajay Patel: for quota math we can expose two numbers: client-visible units (unchanged) + infra_units (internal). infra_units is what billing/alerts use.

Sam Brooks: for fallback we should define reasons: `DIM_MISMATCH`, `NO_CAPACITY`, `TOO_SMALL_BATCH`. each should increment its own metric tag.

Dena Kim: +1. Also, add a console alert rule template: if fallback_rate > 1% over 10m for a route, alert platform-team + owner.

Chris O'Neill: rollout idea: feature-flagged router: start in "observe" mode (emit metrics + header `X-Embed-Routing-Suggested`) then "enforce" where router actually pins. default off.

Marina Liao: we should also document new public semantics so SDKs can opt-in (node/python): `client.embed(..., hint_dims=768)` and we surface a soft-warning in SDK logs when dims missing for mixed arrays.

Ajay Patel: one more: what about large payloads? If user sends many vectors with mixed dims -> preflight should return a `413`-style structured response listing how to split, e.g.:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{ "code": "EMB_PAYLOAD_SPLIT", "suggested_splits": [{"dims":768, "count":120}, {"dims":1024, "count":40}] }
```

Sam Brooks: nice. router + console can run an offline simulation job to estimate cost delta for the suggested split, show in UI.

Dena Kim: we'll need new telemetry indexes: per-route embed_dim, recommended_split, simulated_cost_change. Data retention 30d by default, 90d for enterprise.

Chris O'Neill: what labels do we need on traces? `embed.dim_hint`, `router.shard`, `batch.size`, `batch.latency_ms`, `fallback` — consistent naming please.

Marina Liao: agreed. I'll draft the RFC with schema for events and example SDK PRs. Plan: RFC -> infra proto -> router impl -> console panels -> gradual rollout over 6 weeks.

infra-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch `marina/embedding-prefetch` (build 4219).

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for `marina/embedding-prefetch` -> staging-redwood-west (ETA ~12m).

Ajay Patel: thanks — tagging finance for potential billing UI changes: @Dena please sync with pricing.

Dena Kim: on it. I'll draft console mockups and a billing note.

Sam Brooks: final note: add an E2E test that simulates mixed-dim traffic and asserts p95 latency doesn't regress >10% when enabled.

Marina Liao: sweet. I'll put up the RFC today and add owners. :thumbsup:
